bat_idle: bat hovering in place, wings beating slowly up and down, body bobbing slightly
bat_move: bat flying fast, wings flapping hard in a full stroke from fully raised to fully lowered
bat_alert: bat startled, jerks upward and flares its wings wide, ears up, mouth opening to screech, then hangs in the air
bat_attack: bat attacks: pulls its wings up high, dives down toward the viewer with jaws open to bite, then beats back up to where it started
bat_hurt: bat struck: knocked backward and tilted, wings crumple inward for a moment, then it recovers and spreads them again
bat_death: bat killed: wings fold limp, it tumbles and drops straight down to the ground and lies still on its back, crumpled
lizard_idle: lizard resting in place, breathing, throat pulsing, head turning a little, tail tip twitching
lizard_move: lizard crawling forward to the right in place, legs stepping in a diagonal gait, body and tail swinging side to side
lizard_alert: lizard notices something: pushes up on its front legs, raises its head high and stiffens, tail lifting
lizard_attack: lizard attacks: crouches back, then lunges forward to the right with jaws wide open in a snapping bite, then pulls back to its starting pose
lizard_hurt: lizard struck: flinches backward to the left, body curling and head jerking away, then settles back down
lizard_death: lizard killed: legs give way, it slumps flat to the ground, rolls onto its side with legs curled and lies still
snake_idle: snake coiled in place, slowly swaying its raised head and neck, tongue flicking in and out
snake_move: snake slithering forward to the right in place, body rippling in S-waves along the ground, head held low and level
snake_alert: snake alarmed: rears its head and neck up higher, pulls back into a tight S-coil, mouth opening to hiss
snake_attack: snake strikes: draws its head back, then shoots its head and neck straight forward to the right with jaws open to bite, then recoils back into its coil
snake_hurt: snake struck: head jerks back and away to the left, body writhes, then settles back into its coil
snake_death: snake killed: raised head and neck sag and collapse to the ground, coil loosens and the body lies limp and still, stretched out flat
lizard_alert2: lizard stays flat and low on all four legs, freezes, lifts only its head and neck a little and holds still, tail stiff along the ground. Body never sits up.
lizard_attack2: lizard stays low on all four legs: crouches, then darts its head and front body forward to the right with jaws snapping open, then pulls back
lizard_hurt2: lizard stays low on all four legs: body jolts sideways, head ducks down and tail whips, then it steadies again
snake_move2: snake gliding along: its coils ripple and shift in a travelling wave, the loops sliding and changing shape, raised neck swaying forward and back with each wave
